{{Quote|Sorry to interrupt sir, but you weren't responding.''"<br />"''What is it?''"<br />"''Uh...the Jedi have disarmed the bombs.|This droid speaking to Darts D'Nar|<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref>}}
This '''battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] and participated in the [[Battle of Kiros]].

==Biography==
During the Battle of Kiros, this [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] tried contacting [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] commander [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] to inform him that two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ([[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]) are destroying the bombs planted through out the city, but at the time the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] was fighting [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who managed to break the [[Holoprojector/Legends|Holoprojector]] in the fight and the droid's transmission was interrupted. The droid successfully contacted Darts D'Nar later and informed him that the Jedi had already destroyed the two thermal detonator bombs.

==Behind the scenes==
The B1 battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
